name: Americus Open 2017

venue.name: Student Success Center at Georgia Southwestern State University
venue.address: 800 GSW State University Dr, Americus, GA 31709
venue.details: Enter first hallway on the right past the Chick-fil-a. SSC Conference rooms are directly ahead.

information: The registration fee is $15. There is a 60 person competitor limit with no at-the-door registration. To register, please follow all Instructions on the registration payment tab. Inproper completion of these steps may result in a delay of Registration. If you do not see your name on the compeitors tab after 48 hours of registering, please contact me to resolve the issue. We will be holding the Rubik's Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, 2x2x2 Cube, Rubik's Cube: One-Handed, Pyraminx, and Unofficial: Kilominx.
